status: Tuning tried; VDD repair remains unverified

assumptions: 5 V and 3.3 V have matched start and rise times, with matching +/-5% endpoint variation.
Supervisor release occurs within 1 ms of the calculated high threshold. This is a test allowance, not a datasheet maximum.

VCCL reaches its target within 5 ms after that release. VDD uses 4 ms delay plus a prescribed 16 ms ramp, with no overshoot. The VDD ramp bounds the 47 nF soft-start RC sensitivity at 2.3 uA and the high reference corner; this is not a regulator prediction.
Reset effective capacitance is at least 0.5 uF. This is a sensitivity floor, not a guaranteed manufacturer limit.
Bridge loading, regulator stability, input clamps and capacitor nonlinearities are not simulated.

decision: Retain the existing physical circuit and existing manufacturing files. No candidate was promoted to the board because none passed the unchanged voltage stress and no feed-forward loop response was verified.
openItems: A measured or supported TPS62903 control-loop/transient response is still required for feed-forward selection.
The actual bridge current-step amplitude/rate and the PCB inductances remain unmeasured.
The current board still has VDD stress-screen failures. This attempt does not prove that the real board fails.
The larger-capacitance candidates were model targets; they were not routed, sourced, purchased, or assembled.
Existing reset, slot restart, thermal, firmware and manufacturer-acceptance issues remain separate.
